info.title: ChatTiers Rustlog API
info.summary: Query chat logs, search history, inspect stats, and manage live logging.
info.description:
Use `channel` / `user` when you want login-based routes and `channelid` / `userid` when you already have Twitch ids.

For log endpoints, append `?json`, `?jsonBasic`, `?raw`, or `?ndjson` to switch the response format.
